model_annotation: The plot illustrates how coverage varies with the number of completions for four model conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and uses a logarithmic base-2 scale with tick labels from \(2^0\) through \(2^8\) (i.e., k from 1 to 256) at every power of two. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from about 0.2 up to about 0.95 with major ticks shown at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The “Llama-3B” series is a blue solid line with circular markers that increases from about 0.43 at \(2^0\) to about 0.92 at \(2^8\), rising steadily with no visible declines. The “Llama-3B + FT” series is a green dotted line with upward-triangle markers that similarly increases from about 0.44 at \(2^0\) to about 0.92 at \(2^8\), tracking closely with the blue series across the range. The “Llama-1B” series is a light-blue solid line with circular markers that increases from about 0.25 at \(2^0\) to about 0.88 at \(2^8\), with a steady upward progression. The “Llama-1B + FT” series is a light-green dotted line with upward-triangle markers that rises from about 0.26 at \(2^0\) to about 0.86 at \(2^8\), also increasing monotonically across the x-axis.
